subject: en_guided
source: English National Curriculum — English programmes of study: key stages 1 and 2 (lower KS2, Year 3), DfE 2013 — reading comprehension, taught through VIPERS guided reading skills

weeks.topic: Fluency: reading aloud with expression
objectives: Read aloud with appropriate pace and intonation
Discuss good guided-reading habits

weeks.topic: Retrieve: finding answers in short stories
objectives: Locate answers to literal questions
Underline the evidence in the text

weeks.topic: Vocabulary: word meanings in short stories
objectives: Work out word meanings from the sentence
Replace words with synonyms

weeks.topic: Infer: feelings from actions in short stories
objectives: Infer how a character feels from what they do
Explain inferences using because

weeks.topic: Predict: what happens next in an adventure chapter book
objectives: Make predictions using what has happened so far
Check predictions after reading

weeks.topic: Explain: author's word choices in adventure stories
objectives: Explain why the author chose a particular word
Discuss the effect on the reader

weeks.topic: Summarise: main events of an adventure chapter
objectives: Pick out the most important events
Summarise a chapter in three sentences

weeks.topic: Retrieve: headings and subheadings in information texts
objectives: Use headings to find information quickly
Answer questions from different sections

weeks.topic: Vocabulary: technical words and glossaries
objectives: Find technical words in an information text
Use a glossary to explain them

weeks.topic: Explain: how layout helps the reader
objectives: Explain the purpose of captions, diagrams and bullet points
Discuss why information texts are organised this way

weeks.topic: Infer: mood and atmosphere in poetry
objectives: Infer the mood of a poem
Find words that create the mood

weeks.topic: Explain: rhyme and repetition in poetry
objectives: Explain why poets use rhyme and repetition
Read a poem aloud to show its pattern

weeks.topic: Predict: from illustrations in picture books
objectives: Use illustrations to predict events
Explain how pictures add meaning

weeks.topic: Summarise: retelling a traditional tale in five sentences
objectives: Retell a traditional tale in order
Summarise it in five sentences

weeks.topic: Review: VIPERS skills on a new story
objectives: Practise all VIPERS skills on an unseen story
Identify which skill each question uses

weeks.topic: Retrieve: who, what, where and when in fables
objectives: Find key facts in a fable
Answer questions using the exact words of the text

weeks.topic: Infer: the moral of a fable
objectives: Infer the lesson a fable teaches
Explain how the ending shows the moral

weeks.topic: Vocabulary: synonyms in myths
objectives: Find synonyms for common words in a myth
Explain how stronger words improve description

weeks.topic: Predict: using story patterns in myths
objectives: Use knowledge of myths to predict events
Explain predictions using story patterns

weeks.topic: Explain: heroes and villains in legends
objectives: Explain what makes a character a hero or villain
Use evidence from the legend

weeks.topic: Summarise: key ideas in non-fiction articles
objectives: Find the key idea in each paragraph
Write a short summary of an article

weeks.topic: Retrieve: information from tables and diagrams
objectives: Read information from tables and diagrams
Combine text and diagram information

weeks.topic: Infer: characters' feelings from playscript dialogue
objectives: Infer feelings from what characters say
Read lines aloud to show those feelings

weeks.topic: Vocabulary: idioms in humorous stories
objectives: Work out the meaning of common idioms
Explain why idioms make a story funny

weeks.topic: Explain: how punctuation guides reading aloud
objectives: Explain how punctuation changes the way we read
Read aloud following the punctuation

weeks.topic: Predict: dilemmas in stories from other cultures
objectives: Predict what a character will choose
Explain predictions using cultural details

weeks.topic: Guided reading assessment: VIPERS questions
objectives: Answer VIPERS questions on an unseen text
Explain answers with evidence

weeks.topic: Retrieve: skimming and scanning newspapers
objectives: Skim an article for its main point
Scan for names, dates and numbers

weeks.topic: Explain: fact and opinion in news reports
objectives: Explain the difference between fact and opinion
Sort sentences into facts and opinions

weeks.topic: Infer: characters' motives in mystery stories
objectives: Infer why characters act as they do
Use clues as evidence

weeks.topic: Predict: clues and red herrings in mystery stories
objectives: Predict the solution using clues
Spot misleading clues

weeks.topic: Vocabulary: precise verbs and adjectives in descriptions
objectives: Identify precise verbs and adjectives
Explain the picture they create

weeks.topic: Summarise: the main message of an information leaflet
objectives: Identify the main message of a leaflet
Summarise it in one sentence

weeks.topic: Infer: the poet's feelings in nature poetry
objectives: Infer how the poet feels about nature
Find words that show those feelings

weeks.topic: Sequence and summarise a whole class novel
objectives: Sequence the key events of a whole book
Summarise the story in a paragraph

weeks.topic: End-of-year guided reading assessment
objectives: Answer questions on all VIPERS skills
Use evidence to support every answer

weeks.topic: Review and reading targets for Year 4
objectives: Reflect on strongest and weakest VIPERS skills
Set reading targets for next year
